provenance.provenance_authority: Triptych editorial projection verified by page-image collation against the 1962 target edition
provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: conclusion length differs: the 1962 prints "Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate."; the antecedent prints "Per D6minum. Epistola. T estificor. de Coin-"; accents, ae/oe ligatures and word division differ throughout; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer and its pointing cannot be trusted at comma level. Corroboration: 1922 Mame at artifact PDF p. 632, alignment 0.74; 1570 at lines 58617-58628, alignment 0.68 (degraded-latin; corroboration only). Recorded limitation: The 1962 reading was settled on the facsimile page image; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer only and its letterforms and pointing were not verified on a page image (the 1862's images are not available to this lane, and the Mame's were not rendered for this entry). What was NOT checked: the Benziger conformed printing was used only as a boundary check on the extraction, never as a reading; no attempt was made to establish which of several possible loci in the antecedent is the 'original' one, since an order is not a contribution. This oration is one the Missal draws from a Common; the antecedent witness may print it at the Common, at another saint's day, or at both. That is a difference of position, not of words.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Ecclesiam tuam, quaesumus, Domine, gratia caelestis amplificet: quam beati
Joannis Chrysostomi Confessoris tui atque Pontificis illustrare voluisti
gloriosis meritis et doctrinis. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium
tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Sancti Joannis Chrysostomi Pontificis tui atque Doctoris nobis, Domine, pia
non desit oratio: quae et munera nostra conciliet; et tuam nobis
indulgentiam semper obtineat. Per Dominum nostrum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Ut nobis, Domine, tua sacrificia dent salutem: beatus Joannes Chrysostomus
Pontifex tuus et Doctor egregius, quaesumus, precator accedat. Per Dominum.
